title: A Galera Tá Online: frosted glass with a white glow and stars at the corners
note: An online exhibition of 13 Brazilian artists. Everything sits in frosted glass panels on a green-to-grey gradient: half-white, heavy backdrop blur, a white rim and a big soft white glow that spills outside the panel like light through a window. Each panel and each artwork card has a small white four-point sparkle pinned to its corners. The title is a blue pill in italic grotesk; artwork titles are big light grotesk with the artist in italic serif (by Tuukz), a SOLD OUT 💔 tag. Worth reusing: glass + outer glow + corner sparkles makes a plain card feel precious, and the artist line in a second, italic serif. Built into the star-glass block.
